note:
Ruling 23 (Drew, 2026-09-11). 2022 Topps Chrome's photo/image variations run three tiers. BCP files all three under its own heading word 'Gimmicks' -- never our vocabulary, not carried into this file -- with a per-tier production-code note and an insertion-ratio table (columns 'Cards | Total Cards | Numbered To | Hobby Odds'):

  Tier 1 (BCP verbatim): 'Each Tier 1 Gimmick has a production code of "#CMP054017." We estimate that around 850 copies of each Tier 1 Gimmick were produced.' Table row: 'Gimmicks Tier 1 | 20 | - | 1:640' (odds vary by product; 20 cards). This is the existing Image Variation SP address (image-variation) -- 20 rows already stand, source beckett-scraped-2026-09-01.

  Tier 2 (BCP verbatim): 'Each Tier 2 Gimmick has a production code of "#CMP054023." We estimate that 100 copies of each Tier 2 Gimmick were produced.' Table row: 'Gimmicks Tier 2 | 5 | - | 1:21,698'. This is the existing Image Variation SSP address (image-variation-ssp) -- 5 rows already stand, same source.

  Sonic (BCP verbatim, quoted in full): '### Sonic. On February 24th, 2023, Topps released 2022 Topps Chrome Sonic. Sonic is a re-release of the entire 225-card 2022 Topps Chrome base set, but with new parallels and inserts.' The Gimmicks-only list under that heading: '35 Wander Franco, 83 Josh Lowe, 113 Jarren Duran, 128 Oneil Cruz, 133 Brandon Marsh, 221 Bobby Witt, Jr., 222 Julio Rodriguez, 223 Spencer Torkelson, 224 Hunter Greene, 225 CJ Abrams'. Table row: 'Gimmicks | 10 | - | 1:6399'.

  bcpSonicText (verbatim, the operative sentence): 'These ten Gimmicks are exclusive to Sonic packs.'

PRINT RUN IS BLANK ON PURPOSE -- NOT A GUESS. The insertion table's own column is 'Total Cards | Numbered To | Hobby Odds': the Sonic row's '10' sits under TOTAL CARDS (ten distinct player-cards make up the tier, matching the ten names listed), and NUMBERED TO reads a literal dash. The same table proves the dash is meaningful, not a gap in scraping -- sibling rows in the identical table state real per-card print runs where BCP has them ('Purple/Yellow Sonic Refractor | 220 | 299 | 1:49', down to '... | 5 | 1:122,595'), so BCP clearly CAN and DOES report a serial count when one exists, and chose not to for Gimmicks. No source states a per-card print run for Sonic. Blank means unknown, never a guessed default (feedback_every_ingest_uses_the_one_checklist_format) -- '10' is a card count, not a serial number, and is not written to printRun.

CARDBOARD CONNECTION CROSS-CHECK. ccSonicText: cardboardconnection.com's 2022 Topps Chrome variations page (fetched 2026-09-11) carries NO Sonic or Gimmicks section at all -- its checklist stops at the 25-card SP/SSP refractor variation set ('Base Variations Short Prints Refractors', 20; 'Base Variations Super Short Prints Refractors', 5) and the refractor-parallel ladder. tiersPerCC: two tiers only (SP, SSP); CC is silent on Sonic, not in conflict with it -- it simply never reaches that product (Sonic released 2023-02-24, after Chrome's base checklist). Silence is not disagreement: no card is excluded on this account, and all ten of BCP's Sonic numbers are minted. Had CC published a THIRD-tier list that disagreed with BCP's on membership, this file would have dropped the disagreeing card and reported it -- that case did not arise.

WHY A NEW CARD LINE, NOT SP OR SSP. Sonic is packaged and pulled from an entirely separate 2023 product ('Sonic packs'), carries its own hobby odds (1:6399, distinct from both Gimmick tiers), and BCP's own three-way split (Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Sonic) never folds Sonic into either numbered tier. Existing rows spell the two stated tiers by leaving SP as the DEFAULT (unspelled) address and adding '-ssp' only for the second tier (image-variation, image-variation-ssp; see variationVocabulary.ts). Sonic gets its own spelled word for the same reason SSP got one: image-variation-sonic / 'Image Variation Sonic', never folded onto image-variation or image-variation-ssp.

CENSUS FIRST (prod card_catalog, read-only, 2026-09-11). 2022 topps-chrome rows whose parallel contains 'image variation': 342 total across many spellings. The clean tiered rows: 'Image Variation SP' x20 and 'Image Variation SSP' x5, both source beckett-scraped-2026-09-01 -- exactly the 25-row set this ruling was briefed against. None of the ten Sonic card numbers (35/83/113/128/133/221/222/223/224/225) carries an Image Variation SP or SSP row addressed to Sonic; #221 (Witt) in particular carries only self-derived 'Image Variation Refractor' rows (ingest-auto-seed, ingest-auto-seed-graded) and a user-verified holding parallel 'refractor image variation' -- the exact wrong-address defect variationVocabulary.ts already documents for this holding (2b62a93f). This file adds the missing checklist-backed Sonic address for all ten numbers under the existing topps-chrome key; it does not touch the standing SP/SSP rows.

NO PRINTING PLATES. Neither source names a plate colour for any tier.
